_about: Sprite moves for the HD-2D game. Each character gets one full-body keyframe (FLUX 3) on flat green, then LTX-2 animates every move from it with a locked-off camera. The browser keys out the green and bakes sprite sheets. 'hunter' runs per player from their portrait; the others ship in app/sprites/.
green: flat pure chroma green background (#00FF00) filling the whole frame, evenly lit, no floor, no shadow, no gradient

hunter.keyframe: Full-body side view of the same character as in the reference image, same face, hair and outfit: dark tactical coat with glowing cyan trim, holding a glowing cyan katana in a ready combat stance, body turned to the right, face visible in three-quarter view. The entire body is visible from head to feet with empty space all around, small in the center of the frame. {green}. Semi-realistic Korean action webtoon (manhwa) art, realistic proportions and anatomy, sharp detailed rendering, glossy high-contrast lighting, deep shadows, cold blue and violet aura, glowing eyes, vertical 2:3 frame.

idle.motion: Locked-off static camera, the character stays centered and the same size. Idle combat stance: slow breathing, coat and hair sway gently, the katana glows. The character does not move from its spot. Flat pure green background that never changes. semi-realistic manhwa action style, glossy high-contrast lighting, smooth motion.
